requirements.desc: definition.js shall stop exporting raw FLOW_DEFINITION and TASK_DEFINITION and instead expose definition-side APIs for node lookup, task node lookup, leaf id collection, phase/action mapping, definition order, active node lookup, maxAttempts, sideEffects, runtime step resolution, and lifecycle resolution.
requirements.note: R1: definition exposes APIs instead of raw definition data

requirements.desc: Steps-array-only utilities shall move out of definition.js into a dedicated step-tree module, and all consumers shall import those utilities from the step-tree module.
requirements.note: R2: steps-array utilities live in a dedicated step-tree module

requirements.desc: FlowNode or equivalent definition-side node objects shall carry lifecycle behavior using dedicated action classes with constructor-enforced invariants for status transitions, keep-in-progress behavior, metric increments, issue-log appends, side-effect execution, skip behavior, and hook escape hatches.
requirements.note: R3: lifecycle actions are dedicated classes with invariants

requirements.desc: Definition-side lifecycle resolution shall cover review/gate/finalize status transitions, draft PASS empty triage/repair artifact generation, implementation-review proposal evidence reset from test-execute through finalize-cleanup, downstream skip/reset behavior, sideEffects, maxAttempts, and runtime log step resolution for the lifecycle cases named in Issue #370.
requirements.note: R4: resolveLifecycle returns executable draft review PASS artifact actions

requirements.desc: registry.js hooks shall delegate lifecycle decisions to definition-side APIs or shared lifecycle application helpers and shall not hardcode flow step ids, review phase maps, gate phase maps, or finalize downstream leaf lists for definition-derived decisions.
requirements.note: R5: registry hooks delegate definition-derived lifecycle decisions

requirements.desc: Production modules, helper modules, and tests shall be migrated away from raw definition imports so no caller depends on FLOW_DEFINITION or TASK_DEFINITION as exported data.
requirements.note: R6: production, helper, and shared tests do not import raw definition data

requirements.desc: Existing flow CLI command names, options, help text, JSON envelope shapes, step ids, status transitions, and exit behavior shall remain user-visible compatible after the refactor.
requirements.note: R7: registry keeps command metadata while lifecycle ownership changes

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests shall verify the new definition/registry boundary, raw export removal, step-tree utility relocation, lifecycle action class invariants, draft PASS artifact preservation, implementation-review proposal evidence reset, and representative review/gate/finalize lifecycle transitions.
requirements.note: R8: spec-local coverage observes the definition boundary requirements
